title: The sync gate refuses a push whose deleted or renamed test leaves a done or open item's check selecting no test
goal: kbgit.py sync --push (kg_sync gate_paths and gates) runs backlog.py selectors when the pushed range changes, deletes or renames a _tools/test_*.py file, and refuses the push while a check or repro of a done item of an active sprint selects no test; a zero of an open item's selector is printed as a warning, not refused, since an open item's test may be yet to write (gate zeros, answered done-refuse by the operator). Answers the SP-qzip6qar land, test and ops hygiene retrospective: ST-px3y26ti's suite rewrite (commit 4d70166f) deleted tests that nine done items of SP-qzip6qar checked with tests.py -k, and nothing said so until the review story's done reran them (exit 5 each).

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_sync
a=kg_sync.gate_needs({'_tools/test_x.py'}).get('selectors');b=kg_sync.gate_needs({'_tools/foo.py'}).get('selectors')
print(a,b);sys.exit(0 if a and not b else 1)

gates.question: Which zero-test selectors make the sync gate refuse a push that changes a _tools/test_*.py file? (open items legitimately select no test until their test is written: ST-founcbvo does now)
Does the sync gate refuse for an error row of backlog.py selectors (a selector whose test collection failed) on a done item, or only warn?

notes: Premise: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_sync;print(kg_sync.gate_needs({'_tools/test_x.py'}))" shows no selectors entry: the gate runs check and selfdoc for a changed test file and never backlog.py selectors, which itself exits 0 even when a selector selects none (backlog selectors prints none=N), so the gate must read its none= count. gate_paths diffs names from the merge base, where a rename shows only the new name. Premise run 2026-10-07 on origin/main eee5a6eb: gate_needs({'_tools/test_x.py'}) has no selectors key; reproduces.
